race.comment: OFFICIAL BUSINESS (1) won at this track two runs back before a Belmont third when near the top of betting. He's a progressive talent who is yet to turn in a poor effort and the drop back in distance may hold the key. Looks the one to beat from the inside barrier. SUPERSMASH (5) is the main danger on the class angle, easing from Saturday company after finishing only two and a half lengths from Kraken Time in a 1MW and also holding Open form from Belmont Park. May need some luck from the gate but her best form is good enough. JUNIPER (2) has done little wrong in three starts, including a CL1 win over Artie's Storm. Back out in trip looks a good move for her and it wouldn't surprise to see her get over the top late. CLOBBERCONI (3) is the wildcard, a debutant off a comfortable Belmont trial win and bred from a family with winners. Expecting a bright start. FALLEN CITY (6) was solid on resumption in a good race and has claims.
